description: Schemas for the Master Brain learning loop + cache hierarchy (Phase A/A0). Captured by Northstar_backend/master_brain_learning.py. All local, offline, append-only.

experience_jsonl.description: One JSON object per line in learning/experience.jsonl. Append-only; never overwritten.

playbooks_json.description: learning/playbooks.json — distilled playbooks keyed by intent_signature.

entry.state_hash: sha256 of the invalidation subset at distillation time

l0_cache_json.description: learning/l0_cache.json — deterministic replay keyed by fingerprint = sha256(intent_signature:state_hash).

invalidation_root.description: state_hash = sha256(canonical subset of 00_STATE.json + optional profile sha256).

safety: Live/paid tasks are never auto-replayed; route_request(live=True) returns L3 with requires_approval=true (constitution §3).
